Post-quantum (Falcon-1024, scheme `f1`) interop vectors copied verbatim from
https://github.com/scholtz/dotnet-algorand-sdk/tree/master/test/TestData
(`algokey-pq-accounts.json`, `algokey-pq-signed-{1,2,3}.stxn`), generated with
go-algorand's `algokey pq`. Used by `tests/dotnet_sdk_pq_vectors.rs` (issue #2014)
to prove key derivation and signing are bit-identical. Do not edit.
